from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, time

B = Path('/private/tmp/hawdb-wip-ready-20261015')
TAG = 'main46bf-311091da'
PENDING = B / f'986-final-supplemental-{TAG}-prepare-state.json'
STATE = B / '986-main46bf-supplemental-control-chain-state.json'
assert not STATE.exists()
s = {'status': 'waiting_preparation', 'pid': os.getpid(), 'steps': [],
     'scope': 'Separate opt-in fixture checkpoint controls. Preserve original terminal phase9/10 and its two setup refusals in file1M+1. Resource default1k/large1M+1 six controls and three negative phase controls retain31samples/warmup/full consumer and512-row mutations. Original positive phase groups already qualify their six costs. No original matrix, sample, budget, consumer or deadline replacement.'}
def save():
    STATE.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2) + '\n')
def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def step(role, script):
    log = B / ('986-main46bf-supplemental-' + role + '.log')
    row = {'role': role, 'script': script, 'log': str(log), 'started': time.time()}
    s['steps'].append(row)
    s['status'] = role
    save()
    with log.open('w') as f:
        result = subprocess.run(['python3', '-u', str(B / script)], stdout=f, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    row.update(exit=result.returncode, ended=time.time())
    save()
    assert result.returncode == 0, role
try:
    save()
    prep = json.loads(PENDING.read_text())
    prep_pid = prep['pid']
    while True:
        try:
            prep = json.loads(PENDING.read_text())
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            os.kill(prep_pid, 0)
            time.sleep(5)
            continue
        if prep['status'] != 'preparing':
            break
        os.kill(prep_pid, 0)
        time.sleep(5)
    assert prep['status'] == 'prepared_and_native_built', prep.get('error')
    N = B / ('qualify-resources-final-' + TAG)
    W = B / ('qualify-supplemental-file-final-' + TAG)
    F = B / ('phase-checkpoint-' + TAG + '-frozen-package')
    assert not F.exists()
    assert git(N, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == prep['native_source']
    assert git(W, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == prep['observer_source']
    assert not git(N, 'status', '--porcelain') and not git(W, 'status', '--porcelain')
    assert git(W, 'diff', '--name-only', prep['native_source'], prep['observer_source']).splitlines() == ['qualification/phases/consume.py', 'qualification/resources/numeric.py', 'qualification/resources/numeric_driver.py']
    F.mkdir()
    shutil.copytree(W / 'bindings/python/python/hawdb', F / 'hawdb', ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__', '*.pyc', '*.so', '*.dylib'))
    ext = Path(prep['native_extensions']['lib_hawdb_retained_phase_profile.dylib']['path'])
    assert digest(ext) == prep['native_extensions']['lib_hawdb_retained_phase_profile.dylib']['sha256']
    shutil.copyfile(ext, F / 'hawdb/_hawdb.so')
    shutil.copyfile(W / 'qualification/phases/consume.py', F / 'consume.py')
    shutil.copyfile(W / 'bindings/benchmarks/retained_boundary.py', F / 'retained_boundary.py')
    assert digest(F / 'retained_boundary.py') == 'a9275fa36bd57feddc463a53b60f386d37bebba4337b4fee87040ba35ae3a9d1'
    interpreter = (B / 'resource-qualification/venv/bin/python').resolve(strict=True)
    source = {'engine': prep['engine'], 'engine_tree': '6ea7fb5da52df432df022ac29eab4a74baa6c27b',
              'qualification_base': prep['native_source'], 'qualification_tree': prep['native_tree'],
              'observer_source': prep['observer_source'], 'observer_tree': prep['observer_tree'],
              'file_sha256': {str(p.relative_to(F)): digest(p) for p in F.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},
              'interpreter': {'path': str(interpreter), 'sha256': digest(interpreter)},
              'setup_checkpoint_rows': 65536,
              'scope': 'Explicit untimed fixture maintenance only. Three file1M+1 negative phase modes, original31samples/warmup/full consumer. Original phase9/10, six positive phase cost groups and failed setup remain unchanged; not original10/10 replacement.'}
    (B / ('phase-checkpoint-' + TAG + '-frozen-source.json')).write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2) + '\n')
    (B / ('phase-checkpoint-' + TAG + '-committed-source.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'head': prep['observer_source'], 'tree': prep['observer_tree'], 'engine': prep['engine']}, indent=2) + '\n')
    for role, script in [
        ('resource_controls', f'run-resource-checkpoint-{TAG}.py'),
        ('resource_audit', f'audit-resource-checkpoint-{TAG}.py'),
        ('phase_controls', f'run-phase-checkpoint-{TAG}.py'),
        ('phase_audit', f'audit-phase-checkpoint-{TAG}.py'),
    ]:
        step(role, script)
        if role.endswith('_audit'):
            name = 'resource' if role == 'resource_audit' else 'phase'
            audit = json.loads((B / f'{name}-checkpoint-{TAG}-full-audit.json').read_text())
            assert audit['complete']
    s.update(status='complete_supplemental_only', ended=time.time())
    save()
except BaseException as e:
    s.update(status='failed', error=str(e), ended=time.time())
    save()
    raise
